{{Quote|I need to comm the front office for permission.|Unidentified Chadra-Fan nurse to Embassy-Who-Climbs|<ref name="MK" />}}
This '''individual''' was a [[Chadra-Fan/Legends|Chadra-Fan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nurse/Legends|nurse]] and a member of the [[Pop-Dogs]], an elite unit of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Galactic Alliance Army|Army]].<ref name="MK" /> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> the [[Nurse/Legends|nurse]] was stationed at [[Chakham Army Base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuratooine]], where an unidentified species appeared near the base claiming to be an ambassador for his kind. The species called itself "Embassy-Who-Climbs" and, after learning some words in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] with a [[Unidentified Pop-Dog linguist|xenolinguistics expert]], asked to meet with the planetary leader, [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Galactic Alliance Army|Army]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]].<ref name="MK" />

After meeting with Thaal and concluding a peace treaty, Embassy-Who-Climbs was assigned to the care of the nurse inside the base. Unbeknownst to the Pop-Dogs, the species was actually [[Turman Durra]] in [[Embass suit|disguise]], a member the Galactic Alliance [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit [[Wraith Squadron]] [[Mission to Kuratooine|tasked]] with uncovering Thaal's corrupt activities. Asking to be let out into the sunlight, Durra was informed by the nurse that he needed to obtain permission first. After distracting the nurse, Durra knocked him out with a blow to the head and then proceeded to escape the room using the nurse's code on the keypad, which he had obtained by observing the nurse while pretending to be asleep.<ref name="MK" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
The Chadra-Fan nurse was created by [[Aaron Allston]] for his [[2012]] novel ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'', the tenth volume in the [[Star Wars: X-Wing (novel series)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']] series.<ref name="MK" />
